title: Glass City
description: 80s-inspired synth-pop in E minor at 96 BPM: a shimmering detuned pad and 16th pluck arpeggio open into verses over an octave-bouncing arpeggiated bass, a rising pre-chorus with tom fill, and a bright saw-lead chorus hook driven by a big reverb-drenched, compressed snare (an approximation of gated reverb, since Studio has no gate), with a pad-and-arp breakdown, final chorus and outro; the lead synth stands in for a vocal.
